z-m-10-05.title: Ingaba indlela ekhawulezayo yokufumana umjikelezo isoloko isebenza?
z-m-10-05.topic: Umjikelezo weemilo ezenziwe ngezikwere zegridi, kunye nemida yendlela ekhawulezayo
z-m-10-05.goal: Vavanya ngemizekelo ukuba kwiimilo ezithini indlela ekhawulezayo yokufumana umjikelezo wemilo ukusuka kumjikelezo wenxande ejikelezileyo ichanekile nakweziphi ingachanekanga, uze ucacise iimeko apho isebenza khona ngeempawu zemilo.
z-m-10-05.material:
Isikwere esinye segridi sisikwere esinamacala e-1 cm. Iimilo ezingezantsi zenziwe ngokudibanisa izikwere zegridi macala nomacala, kwaye azinabungxa ngaphakathi. Umjikelezo wemilo bubude bomgca wonke womda ongaphandle, kwaye uquka nomda weenxalenye ezingene ngaphakathi. ■ sisikwere semilo, □ sisikwere esingenanto, kwaye imiqolo ifundwa ukusuka phezulu.
Imilo 가: umqolo 1 ■□ / umqolo 2 ■□ / umqolo 3 ■■
Imilo 나: umqolo 1 ■■■ / umqolo 2 □■□
Imilo 다: umqolo 1 ■□■ / umqolo 2 ■■■
Imilo 라: umqolo 1 □■□ / umqolo 2 ■■■ / umqolo 3 □■□
Imilo 마: umqolo 1 ■□■ / umqolo 2 ■□■ / umqolo 3 ■■■
UJiho: 'Ukuba ufumana umjikelezo wenxande encinci ejikeleza imilo (efakwe kwimigca yegridi), uyafana nomjikelezo wemilo. Ungawufumana ngokukhawuleza!' UHarin: 'Ndibala imiphetho ye-1 cm yomda ongaphandle enye ngenye. Ithatha ixesha, kodwa iqinisekile.'
z-m-10-05.thinking.1: Ukufumana iimeko apho isebenza khona nemizekelo echasayo
z-m-10-05.prereq.0: Ukwazi umjikelezo ngobude bomgca wangaphandle wesimo xa isikwere segridi esinye singu-1 cm (inqanaba leBanga 3-4)
z-m-10-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izimo apho ixabiso elifunyenwe yindlela ka-Jiho (umjikelezo wenxande ejikelezileyo) lifana nexabiso elibaliweyo yindlela ka-Harin (umjikelezo wokwenyani).
z-m-10-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kwisimo ngasinye, kuqala bhala inani lezikwere ngaphesheya nenani lezikwere ezantsi zenxande encinci kakhulu esingena kuyo.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca wangaphandle wesimo ngasinye, bala imiphetho ye-1 cm ngokwahlukileyo ngecala: phezulu, ekunene, ezantsi, nasekhohlo.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba ushiye isimo 가: ukubala imiphetho emifutshane yomgca wangaphandle kunika i-10 cm, kwaye umjikelezo wenxande ejikelezileyo (izikwere ezi-2 ngaphesheya, izikwere ezi-3 ezantsi) nawo ngu-10 cm.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba ushiye isimo 나: umgca wangaphandle ungu-10 cm, kwaye umjikelezo wenxande ejikelezileyo (izikwere ezi-3 ngaphesheya, izikwere ezi-2 ezantsi) nawo ngu-10 cm.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba ukhethe isimo 다: inxande ejikelezileyo ingama-3 izikwere ngaphesheya nama-2 izikwere ezantsi, ngoko umjikelezo wayo ungu-10 cm, kodwa ukuba ubala nemiduli kunye nobuyiselo bomsantsa ophakathi, umjikelezo wokwenyani ungu-12 cm.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.d: Ukuba ushiye isimo 라: umgca wangaphandle ungu-12 cm, kwaye umjikelezo wenxande ejikelezileyo (izikwere ezi-3 ngaphesheya, izikwere ezi-3 ezantsi) nawo ngu-12 cm.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.e: Ukuba ukhethe isimo 마: inxande ejikelezileyo ingama-3 izikwere ngaphesheya nama-3 izikwere ezantsi, ngoko ingu-12 cm, kodwa umsantsa uzulu, ngoko umjikelezo wokwenyani ungu-16 cm.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.explain: Umjikelezo wokwenyani nomjikelezo wenxande ejikelezileyo ngu-10 cm kunye no-10 cm kwisimo 가, 10 cm kunye no-10 cm kwisimo 나, 12 cm kunye no-10 cm kwisimo 다, 12 cm kunye no-12 cm kwisimo 라, kunye ne-16 cm kunye no-12 cm kwisimo 마. Ezo zifanayo zi-가, 나, kunye ne-라. Kwi-다 ne-마, ezinomsantsa ongenisiweyo ngaphakathi, ixabiso luka-Jiho lincinci kunelokwenyani.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.prompt: Cinga ngenxande enamaseli w ngaphesheya nama-h ezantsi, enomsantsa obubanzi be-1 iseli nobunzulu bama-d amaseli unqunyiwe kwindawo enye emqolweni ongaphezulu ongekho kwisiphelo nasiphi. Umsantsa awufikeleli kumphetho ongezantsi, kwaye umqolo o-1 ubuncinane uyashiyeka ngezantsi kwawo. Umzekelo, kukho isimo esine-(w=3, h=2, d=1) nesimo esine-(w=3, h=3, d=2). z-m-10-05.s.s3.prompt: Izimo apho indlela ka-Jihu isebenza khona ziyahluka njani ngefom kwizimo apho ingasebenzi khona? Bhala ukuba yeyiphi ifom eyenza ixabiso luka-Jihu lahluke kumjikelezo wokwenyani.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.hint.0: Thelekisa ngemijikelezo yezimo ozikhethileyo njengezilinganayo kumbuzo 1 nezimo ongazikhethanga.

z-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubhale ukuba umjikelezo wokwenyani uhluke njani ngenxa yalo mahluko?
z-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba usebenzise igama elinye lesimo ubuncinane (가 ukuya ku-마) kwingcaciso yakho?
z-m-10-05.s.s3.model.0: Kwizimo 가, 나, 라, apho amaseli kumqolo aqhubeka ngaphandle kokuqhawuka, indlela ka-Jiho ilungile. Kodwa kwisimo esifana ne-다, apho ophakathi komqolo ongaphezulu ungenanto kwaye umsantsa unesimo ngapha nangapha, imiduli nobuyiselo bomsantsa bubude obungekho kumjikelezo wenxande ejikelezileyo, ngoko umjikelezo wokwenyani mde ngakumbi.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.model.1: Kwisimo esinomsantsa ophakathi, ixabiso luka-Jiho lincinci kunelokwenyani. I-가, 나, 라 azinamsantsa ngoko amaxabiso ayafana, kwaye kwi-다 ne-마 umjikelezo wokwenyani mkhulu ngenxa yemiduli emacaleni omabini omsantsa.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Impendulo echazwe ngo 'inomsantsa / ayinamsantsa' nayo ilungile.
z-m-10-05.s.s3.model.2: Kwi-다 ne-마, iseli elingenanto liphakathi kwe-■ kumqolo ongaphezulu, ngoko umjikelezo ukhula ngaphezu kwowenxande.

z-m-10-03.title: Zingaphi iidiagonal ezinazo ipoligoni?
z-m-10-03.goal: Zama indlela uqikelelo olwenziwe ngedatha encinci olulungiswa ngayo yidatha entsha, uze uxhume inani leediagonal ukusuka kwincopho enye kwinani lonke leediagonal ukuhlola nesizathu somgaqo.

Ikhwadrilateral inamacala ama-4, ipentagoni inamacala ama-5, ihegzagoni inamacala ama-6, kwaye iheptagoni inamacala ama-7. Akukho mfanekiso ubonisiweyo, ngoko zizobele phezu kwephepha.

z-m-10-02.title: Xa iimilo zidibana kwinqaku elinye, ingaba kuya kushiyeka isikhewu okanye ziya kugqubana?
z-m-10-02.goal: Usebenzisa inyaniso yokuba xa amaqhosha eemilo ebuthelwa ngokujikeleza inqaku elinye, iingile kufuneka zidibane zibe lijikelezo elipheleleyo (360°) ukuze kungabikho sikhewu nakugqubana, gweba ngokuthelekisa ubungakanani besikhewu nengile enye yemo, uze wenze wena izisombululo ezininzi.
z-m-10-02.material: Ingile enye yonxantathu olinganayo, isikwere, nehekisagoni elinganayo li-60°, 90°, kunye ne-120° ngokulandelelana. Xa ubuthela amaqhosha eemilo ezininzi kwinqaku elinye, ukuba zonke iingile ezijikeleze eli nqaku zidibana zibe yi-360° (ijikelezo elipheleleyo), zihambelana ncam ngaphandle kwesikhewu nakugqubana. Ukuba isixa singaphantsi kwe-360°, kushiyeka isikhewu, kwaye ukuba singaphezulu kwe-360°, iimilo ziyagqubana. Lo msebenzi uqwalasela kuphela "ukujikeleza inqaku elinye", kwaye awuqwalaseli nokuba umgangatho obanzi unganciphiswa ngokupheleleyo. Akukho mfanekiso obonisiweyo.

Ingile phakathi kweengalo ezimbini ithetha ingile ekwicala elingagqithiyo kwi-180°. Akukho mfanekiso obonisiweyo, ngoko cinga ubuso bewotshi engqondweni.
